programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: The Calling of a Bus Driver
programme.desc: Based on a true story, a girl named Suki aspire to fulfill her dream after leaving with her cheating boyfriend. Later, when invited to attend his wedding, she schemes to have her revenge.

programme.title: The Infernal Walker
programme.desc: An undercover police who infiltrated the triad and a triad mole planted into the police force must work together to survive the cutthroat underworld.

programme.title: To Live And Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Disoriented and trapped in notorious, vice-ridden Mongkok, a once-feared triad figure struggles to adapt to life in the wake of his 30-year prison sentence.

programme.title: Last Suspect
programme.desc: A lawyer must defend a murder suspect and win the case in order to save her daughter who has been taken hostage. As evidence emerges, she unveils the truth and the man behind the case.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li goes undercover to shut down Life Hotel but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As he realizes it serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and his empathy.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man & a couple.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Kim is suffering from Alzheimer's disease but Ginger suspects that he is a film critic profiting from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger gets closer to him and uncovers his secrets and sorrows.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths.

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: Queen of Mahjong
programme.desc: This Chinese New Year comedy follows three young couples navigating love, laughter, and long-held family secrets—with plenty of drama both around and on the mahjong table.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan gains the trust of criminal Tian while gathering evidence against his gang. As Shan successfully destroys Tian's gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: The Kwoks and What
programme.desc: This family drama depicts Kwok Law Mei Lan, a mother who goes all out to help her three adult children who are burdened with problems, to free themselves - and find their way forward.
